using System;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Text;

namespace SocketCreation
{
    public class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            string serverIP = "10.0.12.133"; // Replace with your server IP address
            int port = 4443; // Replace with your desired port number

            try
            {
                // Create a TCP client
                TcpClient client = new TcpClient(serverIP, port);

                Console.WriteLine("Connected to the server.");

                // Get the network stream from the client
                NetworkStream stream = client.GetStream();

                // Send data to the server
                string message = "10.0.10.133:6379::3";
                byte[] data = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(message);
                stream.Write(data, 0, data.Length);

                Console.WriteLine("Data sent to the server.");

                string a = Console.ReadLine();

                if(a == "a")
                {
                    // Close the stream and client
                    stream.Close();
                    client.Close();
                }


            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("Error: " + ex.ToString());
            }

            Console.WriteLine("Press Enter to exit.");
            Console.ReadLine();
        }
    }
}
